headline: Sandeep Gupta files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for Asian Hotels (West) Limited
sum: Sandeep Gupta has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations to the NSE, disclosing concert party or subsequent shareholding in Asian Hotels (West) Limited.
detail: The disclosure was filed with the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure of concert parties or revised holdings in specified situations.
